nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) tracking accounts authorized to call authed functions; 1 = authorized, 0 = not.
Reference to the SAFEEngineLike core engine used for internal coin transfers.
External ERC-20 style representation of the system coin (DSTokenLike), minted/burned by this adapter.
Flag (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled) controlling whether exit() can be used.
Number of decimals of the external system coin, set to 18 in the constructor.
Constant 10**27 used to convert wad (18 decimals) amounts into rad (45 decimals) internal amounts.
External, isAuthorized function that grants authorization to an account by setting authorizedAccounts[account] = 1.
External, isAuthorized function that revokes authorization from an account by setting authorizedAccounts[account] = 0.
Modifier that requires authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] == 1 before executing the guarded function; the contract's access-control gate.
Constructor: authorizes msg.sender, enables the contract, wires safeEngine and systemCoin, sets decimals to 18.
External, isAuthorized function that permanently disables the contract by setting contractEnabled = 0.
Internal pure function performing an overflow-checked multiplication of two uint256 values.
External function: burns external coins from msg.sender and transfers RAY-scaled internal coins from this contract to the account.
External function: pulls RAY-scaled internal coins from msg.sender to this contract and mints external coins to the account, only when contractEnabled == 1.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, coin burning, and as the internal-coin source in exit().
External call in join(): safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(address(this), account, multiply(RAY, wad)); executed before minting/burning side effects.
External call in join(): systemCoin.burn(msg.sender, wad); burns external coins from the caller.
External call in exit(): safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(msg.sender, address(this), multiply(RAY, wad)); pulls internal coins from the caller.
External call in exit(): systemCoin.mint(account, wad); mints external coins to the target account.
Overflow-checked multiplication z = x * y inside multiply(); require reverts on overflow.
Parameter 'account' of addAuthorization: address to be authorized.
Parameter 'account' of removeAuthorization: address whose authorization is revoked.
Constructor parameter 'safeEngine_': address of the SAFEEngine implementation.
Constructor parameter 'systemCoin_': address of the external system coin token.
Parameter 'x' of multiply: multiplicand.
Parameter 'y' of multiply: multiplier.
Parameter 'account' of join: recipient of the joined internal coins.
Parameter 'wad' of join: 18-decimal amount of external coins to join.
Parameter 'account' of exit: recipient of the minted external coins.
Parameter 'wad' of exit: 18-decimal amount of internal coins to exit.
Local variable 'z' in multiply(): result of x * y, returned on success.

edges.reason: addAuthorization is guarded by the isAuthorized modifier which validates authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] == 1.
removeAuthorization is guarded by the isAuthorized modifier, restricting who can revoke authorization.
disableContract is guarded by the isAuthorized modifier, restricting who can disable the adapter.
The modifier indexes authorizedAccounts with the untrusted msg.sender to decide whether the call is permitted.
The isAuthorized modifier reads the authorizedAccounts state mapping for the caller.
The 'account' parameter flows into the authorization mapping write performed by addAuthorization.
addAuthorization writes authorizedAccounts[account] = 1, modifying privileged access state.
The 'account' parameter flows into the authorization mapping write performed by removeAuthorization.
removeAuthorization writes authorizedAccounts[account] = 0, modifying privileged access state.
Constructor parameter safeEngine_ is used to initialize the safeEngine state variable.
Constructor parameter systemCoin_ is used to initialize the systemCoin state variable.
The constructor grants authorization to the untrusted msg.sender (authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] = 1).
Constructor assigns the wrapped SAFEEngineLike reference to safeEngine.
Constructor assigns the wrapped DSTokenLike reference to systemCoin.
Constructor enables the contract by setting contractEnabled = 1.
Constructor writes the authorization mapping for msg.sender.
disableContract writes contractEnabled = 0, disabling exits.
Parameter x of multiply feeds the checked multiplication.
Parameter y of multiply feeds the checked multiplication.
multiply executes the checked multiplication z = x * y guarded by a require against overflow.
Operand x flows into the checked multiplication; overflow would revert the transaction.
Operand y flows into the checked multiplication; overflow would revert the transaction.
Result of the checked multiplication is assigned to the local variable z.
Local z is returned as the result of multiply.
The RAY constant is used as the x operand when scaling wad amounts in multiply(RAY, wad).
Parameter account of join is used as the internal coin recipient in transferInternalCoins.
Parameter wad of join determines the burned and transferred amounts.
msg.sender supplies the address whose external coins are burned in join.
join calls multiply(RAY, wad) to convert the wad amount into rad.
join performs an external call to safeEngine.transferInternalCoins before completing its own state effects.
join performs an external call to systemCoin.burn(msg.sender, wad), giving an untrusted token control flow.
A malicious safeEngine implementation invoked by transferInternalCoins can re-enter join before it finalizes.
A malicious system coin token can call back into join during burn().
The RAY-scaled wad amount is passed as the int256 argument of transferInternalCoins in join.
Parameter account of exit is the recipient of the minted external coins.
Parameter wad of exit determines the internal coins pulled and external coins minted.
msg.sender is the source address of the internal coin transfer in exit.
exit reads contractEnabled to enforce require(contractEnabled == 1) before proceeding.
exit calls multiply(RAY, wad) to convert the wad amount into rad.
exit performs an external call to safeEngine.transferInternalCoins, an untrusted external interaction.
exit performs an external call to systemCoin.mint(account, wad), an untrusted external interaction.
A malicious safeEngine can call back into exit during transferInternalCoins before balance effects settle.
A malicious system coin token can re-enter exit during mint().
The wad amount from exit flows into systemCoin.mint as the minted quantity.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter account is only used to write the authorizedAccounts authorization mapping inside addAuthorization and has no independent semantics.
Parameter account is only used to clear the authorizedAccounts authorization mapping inside removeAuthorization.
Constructor parameter safeEngine_ is solely used to initialize the safeEngine state variable.
Constructor parameter systemCoin_ is solely used to initialize the systemCoin state variable.
Parameter x of multiply is a transient operand of the overflow-checked multiplication.
Parameter y of multiply is a transient operand of the overflow-checked multiplication.
Parameter account of join only supplies the recipient for the internal coin transfer.
Parameter wad of join only supplies the amount burned and RAY-scaled inside join.
Parameter account of exit only supplies the recipient of the minted external coins.
Parameter wad of exit only supplies the amount transferred internally and minted externally.
Local variable z is the temporary result of the checked multiplication and is immediately returned by multiply.
